Definition: to lie alongside (i.e. in wait); by implication, to catch an animal (figuratively, men); to victual (for a journey)
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses tsûwd where it means to hunt, to lie in wait. In Genesis 27:3, take me some venison, and it appears again in Leviticus 17:13.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hunt in Genesis and the law in Leviticus both teach me that taking life is never casual before God.
